2609.10539.title: IdeaAMBIG: Benchmarking Implementation-Critical Gaps in Research-Idea Specifications
2609.10539.paper_summary: A research idea may be novel, coherent, and scientifically plausible, yet its proposed method may remain insufficiently specified for faithful implementation. We study the codification readiness of implementation-facing research-method specifications, defined by whether they provide sufficient methodological information for a competent implementer or coding agent to construct the intended method without unsupported assumptions. We construct evidence-grounded specifications and their supported resolutions from papers, codebases, issue threads, and reproduction artifacts. We introduce IdeaAMBIG, a benchmark of 660 evidence-grounded instances: 163 real-world gaps from reproducibility reports and GitHub issues, and 497 controlled synthetic gaps injected into codification-ready references. IdeaAMBIG evaluates three capabilities: codification-readiness assessment, defect localization, and clarification action generation. Defect localization receives only the specification, whereas clarification additionally receives the annotated defect. Across 13 LLMs, the best model achieves 9.6% Macro Defect Recovery Rate on real-world instances but 80.6% Macro Clarification Action Success Rate when given the defect. In an oracle study, supplying the gold resolution raises the downstream codification-ready rate from 14% to 98%. Across all evaluated models, defect localization is the main bottleneck, with stronger clarification given the defect.
2609.10539.paper_summary_zh: 一個研究想法可能是新穎的、一致的，並且在科學上是合理的，但其提出的方法可能仍然不足以具體化以便忠實實施。<lb/>我們研究面向實施的研究方法規範的編碼準備性，這是由它們是否提供足夠的方法論信息來定義的，以便讓有能力的實施者或編碼代理在沒有不支持的假設的情況下構建所需的方法。<lb/>我們從論文、代碼庫、問題討論串和重現文物中構建基於證據的規範及其支持的解決方案。<lb/>我們介紹了IdeaAMBIG，一個包含660個基於證據的實例的基準：163個來自重現報告和GitHub問題的現實世界差距，以及497個注入到編碼準備參考中的受控合成差距。<lb/>IdeaAMBIG評估三種能力：編碼準備性評估、缺陷定位和澄清行動生成。<lb/>缺陷定位僅接收規範，而澄清則額外接收標註的缺陷。<lb/>在13個大型語言模型中，最佳模型在現實世界實例上達到了9.6%的宏觀缺陷恢復率，但在給定缺陷時達到了80.6%的宏觀澄清行動成功率。<lb/>在一項預言者研究中，提供金標準解決方案將下游編碼準備率從14%提高到98%。<lb/>在所有評估的模型中，缺陷定位是主要瓶頸，並且在給定缺陷的情況下，澄清效果更強。
